```{r input}
StopsData <- readRDS("StopsData.rds")
Cities <- read_xlsx("ACTransitNorthWardsCities.xlsx")
Reps <- read_xlsx("ACTransitNorthWardsReps.xlsx")
```

# Contact Info for Line 7 ACTransit Directors

```{r contact}
kable(Reps)
```

# Directors by City

I count named unincorporated areas as cities.

```{r cities}
Cities %>% arrange(City) %>% kable()
```

# Number of Stops by City

The total number of stops is `r nrow(StopsData)`.

```{r by city}
StopsData %>% 
  group_by(City) %>% 
  summarize(Stops = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Stops)) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round((Stops / sum(Stops)) * 100)) %>% 
  kable()
```
# Full List of Stops

Sorted by geo coordinate latitude from north to south.

```{r stops data list, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=FALSE}
StopsData %>% 
  arrange(desc(Latitude)) %>% 
  mutate(Stop = paste0(`Stop Number`, " - ", `Stop Name`),
         Direction = str_sub(Direction, 1, 1)) %>% 
  select(Stop, Direction, City) %>% 
  left_join(Cities) %>% 
  kable()
```
